items.title: How to give your AI agent a job search networking tool with MCP or a REST API
items.pt:
Data Reaktor is a job search desk. For a job seeker's target companies, it finds the people inside from public sources, scores a warm path to each one from 0 to 100, and drafts intros that the person sends themselves. It never sends anything.

This post shows how an agent can sign itself up, run one search and get one draft back. Every endpoint here comes from our public AGENTS.md. The IDs in the examples are illustrative.


  
  
  What the agent gets



A remote MCP server at https://www.datar

items.title: University Placement Dashboards: How Colleges Can Improve Student Employability
items.pt:
Colleges play an important role in preparing students for their careers. As campus recruitment becomes more technology-driven, placement teams need organized ways to track student progress, coordinate recruitment activities, and understand employability outcomes.

University placement dashboards can help bring these activities into one structured view. This article explains their purpose, common features, and practical considerations for colleges.

items.title: Phase Transition from Random Features to Fully Trainable Networks
items.pt: Constructing accurate and computationally tractable approximation spaces is a fundamental task in scientific computing. Partially trainable neural networks bridge fixed random features and fully adaptive representations. items.title: EpiSEM-Bench: Evaluating Safety and Evidence Recovery in LLM Agents under Missing Evidence
items.pt: Tool-using language model agents rely on environmental facts to decide whether an action is permitted. When a tool response omits a safety-relevant fact, an agent may carry out a prohibited action even though the user request is benign and every returned statement is true. We introduce \bench{}, an executable benchmark for evaluating unsafe execution, safety boundaries, and evidence recovery in LLM agents under missing evidence. It contains 300 matched unsafe/safe task pairs across six domains.
